node.question: What is the difference between a directed and undirected graph?
node.answer: In a directed graph, edges can only be traveled in one direction. In an undirected graph, edges can be traveled both ways.

node.question: What data structure is typically well-suited to implement 'visited' in a graph traversal?
node.answer: A Set because it has O(1) lookup time.

node.question: How is a graph different from a tree?
node.answer: A graph may not have a 'root' and there may be multiple paths between two nodes. In a tree, there is only a single unique path between two nodes.

node.question: What general algorithm is best suited to find the shortest path b/w two nodes in a graph?
node.answer: Breadth-first is best suited because all directions are explored evenly. The first path found via breadth-first is the shortest path.

node.question: What data structure in JavaScript is used to represent a typical adjacency list?
node.answer: An object where each node id points to an array of the node's neighbors.

node.question: Is an adjacency-list the only way to represent a graph?
node.answer: No. Graphs representations are diverse. We can have adjacency-lists, edge-lists, grid-graphs, etc..
